The bowl appears to be about 15 cm across, which fits the plywood strip behind it (roughly 15 cm wide). It holds a soft white, creamy mound that looks like plain yogurt, sour cream, or mayo. The texture is smooth and glossy, so I read it as thick yogurt.

For volume, the mound covers about 9 cm across and stands about 3 cm high, so it is roughly a dome shape. A dome of radius 4.5 cm and height 3 cm has a volume of about 0.5 × (4/3)π × 4.5² × 3 ≈ 127 cm³. A heaped, slightly flattened mound is probably closer to 150 g, and I'll use that. Plain whole-milk yogurt is about 65 kcal/100 g, and a thicker Greek-style yogurt would be around 100.

I'll go with 150 g at 70 kcal/100 g.
